hypotheses.D0_leading_sensitivity_direction_is_nati: For both groups, route/full leading-vector input cosine and 1%-finite effect fidelity have median >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80.
hypotheses.D1_state_contraction_predicts_finite_rou: Across all records, cosine between route/full state projections has Spearman correlation >=0.60 with their 5%-finite effect fidelity.
hypotheses.D2_route_recovers_full_active_projection: For both groups, route/full state-projection cosine has median >=0.90 and 10th percentile >=0.70.
hypotheses.D3_literal_projection_effect_transfers: For both groups, literal route- versus full-projection effects have median fidelity >=0.80 and 10th percentile >=0.50.
hypotheses.D4_full_literal_component_beats_random: For both groups, full-subspace literal-removal KL is at least 3x the median literal-removal KL of matched random subspaces.
